name: Aurelune
pitch: Recruit heroes from a hopeful fantasy world, form alliances through race and class, and outplay seven rival captains on a magical board.
tournament_explanation: The Dawn Compact runs enchanted field trials to prepare mixed teams for the encroaching Hollow Court. Arena manifestations dissolve safely when defeated; competitive matches are training contests, not the entire war. Duplicate recruits and star upgrades are explicit game abstractions rather than a cloning economy.
antagonist: The Hollow Court is a supernatural host crossing damaged wards beyond Cindercrest. Its leaders seek control of the old beacon network. Playable peoples are not inherently aligned with it; the threat is an organization and its choices, not a race.

regions.name: Brighthaven Vale
regions.look: Warm limestone, blue roofs, hanging gardens, oak beams and sunlit market cloth.
regions.culture: Patrol captains, farmers, students and traveling craftspeople negotiate common road duties.
regions.stake: Keep bridges and market routes open so the alliance can supply distant settlements.

regions.name: Thistlewood Reach
regions.everyday_place: A canopy tea garden serving visitors from several peoples
regions.look: Ancient broadleaf trunks, curved wooden galleries, turquoise ponds and restrained luminous flowers.
regions.culture: Forest stewardship and public songs carry local histories; visitors trade and learn rather than being automatically excluded.
regions.stake: Preserve the forest road and understand the changes in the night sky.

regions.name: Stoneveil Deeps
regions.everyday_place: Orla’s shared hall and open workshops
regions.look: Large stone vaults, amber furnace windows, bronze railings and cultivated subterranean gardens.
regions.culture: Craft guilds judge useful work and reliable public infrastructure; residents include migrants and travelers.
regions.stake: Repair the old routes and send dependable materials to the frontier.

regions.name: Stormstep Highlands
regions.look: Sun-ochre stone, grassy terraces, broad geometric textiles and clear mountain skies.
regions.culture: Caravan communities cooperate across long distances and treat navigation and mutual aid as serious skills.
regions.stake: Prevent isolation when dangerous weather and hostile incursions close the passes.

regions.name: Willowrun Rivers
regions.everyday_place: Riverside bakeries, gardens and boat markets
regions.look: Warm plaster, green orchards, colorful cloth, waterwheels and low welcoming bridges.
regions.culture: Traveling festivals, agriculture and trade connect the wider world rather than making this region merely comic relief.
regions.stake: Maintain food and communications without losing the everyday pleasures the coalition protects.

regions.name: Cindercrest Heights
regions.everyday_place: Terraced gardens and map rooms beside the beacons
regions.look: Pale mountain rock, teal banners, golden beacon housings and prismatic old ruins.
regions.culture: Beacon keepers and travelers exchange maps, astronomy and maintenance duties.
regions.stake: Seal damaged wards without surrendering the frontier or treating outsiders as enemies.

factions.name: Dawn Compact
factions.purpose: Coordinate training, relief and joint defense.

factions.name: Greenward Circle
factions.purpose: Maintain forest routes, observatories and shared knowledge.

factions.name: Hearthwright Union
factions.purpose: Provide reliable craft, safe halls and infrastructure.

factions.name: Highland Watch
factions.purpose: Guide and defend caravans across the passes.

factions.name: Wayfarer Fellowship
factions.purpose: Keep trade, food and ordinary community life connected.

factions.name: Skyward Conclave
factions.purpose: Care for the beacon network and study the breach.
